facts.fact: L'Express reports that the Ministry of ICT (MITCI), with the Data Protection Office, officially launched the Mauritius National Data Strategy 2025-2029 ('A New Era of Trust') at Ebene on 28 January 2026, setting the country's long-term vision for responsible data governance and strategic use of data.

systems.owner: Ministry of Information Technology, Communication and Innovation (MITCI), with the Data Protection Office
